verdict.rationale: Mem0 exposes an MCP server with add/search/update tools, a documented CLI with a --json agent mode covering add/search/get/list/update/delete, and REST/SDK APIs, all verified at runtime (mem0-probe-rt-1, mem0-probe-rt-3, mem0-docs-2/14/34). This lets an agent autonomously invoke memory operations mid-conversation via tools it calls itself. missing for 10: independent third-party case study of an agent actually driving delete/update autonomously in production, and the hosted MCP server requires OAuth which adds friction not fully demonstrated end-to-end.
